ladder.title: Send replies about {{topic}} automatically?
ladder.body: In the last {{days}} days you approved {{count}} replies about {{topic}} exactly as the assistant wrote them. You edited none, rejected none, and none failed to send.
ladder.note: Prices, bookings and promotions keep asking you first. You can switch this off again at any time in the automation settings.
ladder.dismissHint: If you choose "Not now", we will not suggest this again for a while.
ladder.confirmBody: From now on the assistant sends replies about {{topic}} by itself, as long as the facts it uses are verified and nothing else needs a person. Every other topic keeps asking you first.
